scope: synthetic architecture sensitivity, not hardware or full-model end-to-end measurement
nuisance: one uniformly chosen chip unavailable at phase start for specified residual stall; other chips start idle; iid occurrence per phase only in token oracle experiment
negative_control: homogeneous read-only p=0, and every stall_ns=0 case
read_only_gc: read-only model weights do not generate GC; nonzero nuisance presumes shared-device writes/GC/maintenance and is not calibrated
physical_family: g16 equal whole-row base; canonical wave-aligned row tiles; one alternate per tile; cyclic source->destination shifts keep capacity equal
online_selector: exact minmax redirection; all baselines have identical selector
fit: first 100 existing training prompts only; deterministic sample of decode events
validation: last 100 existing training prompts, 128 steps; evaluated after fit per case; the same loaded training cache contains both halves, but no validation routes are passed to fitting; original corpus test_routes never opened
excluded: FTL state, write/GC simulation, interference correlation, multiple blocked chips, host activation/combine, full-model timing, physical energy, extra tile command costs
overhead_note: additional addressing/setup must be charged in deployment; NAND-only policy gains are optimistic. Existing per-phase fixed costs enter only the full-token oracle bound, not conditional phase policy tables.
